# LocaRec 0.7.1
### Changed
- Recordings are now saved to a folder you pick, not to a hidden folder inside the app. The first time you record or import, LocaRec asks where to keep them; after that it remembers. You can move the folder later from Settings, and any recordings already made move with it.
### Fixed
- Recordings made by earlier versions are moved out of the app's private storage into your chosen folder the first time you pick one. If a file cannot be moved because something with the same name is already there, the original is left alone and LocaRec tries again next launch.
